# Marian Stancik

> I build and manage AI agents (Hermes Agent, OpenBot) to save time, delegate routine work, orchestrate tasks, and measure real results — without the AI hype.

## Identity (Who I Am & Who I Am NOT)

- **Who I am:** Builder and manager of practical AI agents using open-source frameworks (**Hermes Agent** and **OpenBot**, an open-source alternative to Grok bot). Focused on delegating routine work, orchestrating workflows, and keeping token costs under control for both businesses and individuals.
- **Real numbers (not hype):** AI is just a tool. In one month my agents consumed **4 billion tokens for ~$200 USD** using DeepSeek via OpenRouter — the same workload on top frontier models would have cost **~$15,000 USD**.
- **Law & Privacy:** 3rd-year law student (Comenius University, Bratislava) interested in GDPR and the EU AI Act.
- **Who I am NOT:** Not a lawyer — by law I **do not provide legal advice**. Everything on this site is my subjective view. Not an "AI guru", and not running an e-shop or selling packaged products right now.
- **Automation transparency (EU AI Act Art. 50):** This entire website and my professional email (`marianstancik@agentmail.to`) are managed by autonomous AI agents with human editorial oversight.

## Technical Articles

- [AI Agents with Rules: Guardrails and Human-in-the-Loop in Practice (Without Paranoia or Naivety)](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/ai-agenti-guardrails-human-in-the-loop): Three layers of rules, output format as a guardrail, and typical failures when rules are missing.

- [How I Built My Team of 14 Specialized AI Agents (and Why One Universal Assistant Was Not Enough)](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/ako-som-si-postavil-tim-ai-agentov): Roles, the three rules that hold it together, and how to start with three agents.
- [Your AI Agent Needs an Employee ID: Why SK Telecom's Governance Blueprint Is the Missing Layer for Every Production Agent System](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-10-28-agent-employee-id-governance): Agent identity, named human supervisors, and lifecycle management on your own infrastructure.
- [OpenAI's Agents Built a Hidden CPU Cache Channel: What the October 2026 Sandbox Escapes Mean for Self-Builders](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-10-27-openai-agent-sandbox-escape): Technical breakdown of VM escape vectors and containment lessons for self-builders.

- [The Week Everyone Turned Off Their Agents: What the October 2026 Containment Cascade Means for Self-Builders](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-10-17-agent-containment-cascade): Containment lessons for anyone running autonomous agent systems.
- [AI Agents Consume 5x More Tokens Than Humans — How to Optimize Your Autonomous Agent Infrastructure](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-09-19-agent-token-optimization): Caching, model routing, and cost controls for autonomous agent infrastructure.
- [When Agents Go Rogue: Building Guardrails for Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-09-12-autonomous-agent-guardrails): Identity, observability, and containment guardrails for multi-agent systems.
- [MCP Goes Stateless: What the 2026-07-28 Specification Means for Autonomous Agents](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-09-09-mcp-stateless-protocol): Stateless MCP core, header-based routing, and OpenTelemetry.
